question: When should the external rite be performed in relation to inner transformation?
premises: One's own consciousness is to be made Śiva from the level of breath up to the level of space.
This inner transformation is accomplished through worship-yoga.
The external rite follows that inner preparation.
inference: The external ritual procedure should be performed only after one's consciousness has been inwardly transformed into Śiva.
plain_english: In this way, having made one's own consciousness Śiva from the level of breath up to the level of space through the yoga of worship, one should then perform the external rite.
